title: Technical Support Lead- Infrastructure & Cloud
description:
Overview:  
Here's a more polished, professional, and attractive version of the job description:

IT Support Lead - Cloud & InfrastructureAbout the Role

We are looking for a proactive and technically skilled **IT Support Lead** to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced IT professional who is passionate about delivering exceptional customer support, leading high-performing teams, and managing both cloud and on-premises infrastructure environments.

As the IT Support Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing technical support operations, resolving complex issues, guiding support engineers, and driving cloud adoption strategies for our clients. The ideal candidate combines strong leadership capabilities with deep technical expertise across modern cloud platforms and traditional IT infrastructure.

Key ResponsibilitiesLeadership & Service Delivery

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of IT support engineers to ensure outstanding customer service and technical excellence.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues, ensuring timely resolution and minimal business disruption.
* Establish and maintain support processes, service standards, and best practices to improve operational efficiency.
* Conduct regular team training sessions and knowledge-sharing initiatives to enhance technical capabilities.

Client Engagement & Consulting

* Build strong relationships with clients by understanding their business and technology requirements.
* Provide strategic IT recommendations and serve as a trusted advisor for infrastructure and cloud solutions.
* Deliver exceptional customer experience through proactive communication and issue management.

Cloud & Infrastructure Management

* Design, deploy, and manage secure, scalable, and high-performing cloud environments across:
* Microsoft Azure
* Amazon Web Services (AWS)
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Monitor cloud resources to optimize performance, cost efficiency, reliability, and security.
* Support hybrid IT environments integrating on-premises infrastructure with cloud-based services.
* Manage server, network, storage, virtualization, and endpoint technologies.

Technical Support & Operations

* Troubleshoot and resolve advanced infrastructure, networking, system, and application issues.
* Provide ongoing maintenance, upgrades, and support for business-critical applications and services.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge-base articles.
* Ensure compliance with security standards, backup policies, and disaster recovery procedures.

Projects & Business Growth

* Participate in IT transformation initiatives, cloud migrations, infrastructure upgrades, and system deployments.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to identify opportunities for managed services and cloud solutions.
* Assist in technical pre-sales discussions, solution design, and client presentations.

Required Qualifications

* Minimum **2+ years of experience in IT Support**, with at least **1+ year in a leadership, team lead, or supervisory role**.
* Strong hands-on experience with cloud computing platforms such as **AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**.
* Solid understanding of cloud service models including **IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS**.
* Experience managing Windows and Linux server environments.
* Knowledge of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewalls, and security best practices.
* Experience with virtualization technologies such as **VMware, Hyper-V**, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as **Docker** and **Kubernetes**.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex technical challenges.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Google Cloud Certified - Professional Cloud Architect
* ITIL Foundation Certification
* Microsoft 365 Administration experience
* Experience with cybersecurity and compliance frameworks
* Knowledge of automation and scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python)

What We Offer

✅ Opportunity to work with cutting-edge cloud technologies  
✅ Leadership role with career growth potential  
✅ Exposure to diverse IT environments and enterprise clients  
✅ Collaborative and innovative work culture  
✅ Continuous learning, certification, and professional development support

Join Us

If you are passionate about technology, enjoy solving complex challenges, and have the leadership skills to drive exceptional IT support services, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and help organizations transform their IT operations through innovative cloud and infrastructure solutions.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹150,000.00 - ₹360,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement

Education:

* Diploma (Preferred)

Experience:

* Technical support: 1 year (Required)
* total work: 1 year (Required)

Language:

* English (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Technical Support Engineer to monitor day-to-day transaction processing, identify and troubleshoot production issues, and ensure seamless application operations. The role involves incident management, transaction monitoring, data analysis, help desk support, and coordination with internal teams, DBAs, merchants, and other stakeholders. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work in a fast-paced production environment and ensure timely resolution of operational and technical issues.

Key Responsibilities:

* Monitor production transactions and proactively identify issues, anomalies, unexpected failures, and performance bottlenecks.
* Analyze incidents, perform initial troubleshooting, and escalate issues to the appropriate technical teams when required.
* Report application, system, and transaction-related issues to development, infrastructure, DBA, and other relevant departments.
* Coordinate with the DBA team to extract, validate, and analyze data as required for operational and business needs.
* Handle help desk tickets, service requests, and incident management activities within defined SLAs.
* Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders, business teams, and merchants to provide updates and resolution status.
* Investigate customer-reported issues and ensure timely resolution or escalation.
* Monitor application logs, alerts, and system health to maintain service availability.
* Prepare incident reports, RCA documentation, and operational status updates.
* Support production deployments, verification activities, and post-release monitoring.

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 6 months - 1 years of experience in Technical Support, Application Support, Production Support.
* Experience in monitoring production applications, transactions, and resolving operational issues.
* Basic knowledge of Linux/Unix commands and troubleshooting.
* Hands on experience working with databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or TiDB, including data extraction and validation.
* Understanding of web applications, APIs, payment processing systems, and transaction flows.
* Hands-on experience with ticketing and incident management tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams, stakeholders, and merchants.

Skills and Experience:

* Strong knowledge of Linux command-line operations, log analysis, and server troubleshooting.
* Hands on experience working with MySQL, MongoDB, and TiDB databases, including data extraction, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and advanced spreadsheet functions.
* Familiarity with AI-powered tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, and similar productivity tools for analysis, documentation, and troubleshooting.
* Basic programming knowledge in any one of the following languages: Python, Go, PHP, or Node.js.
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and web application workflows.

Application Question(s):

* Specify your total experience in Months ?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Support Coach
description:
The Tech Coach plays a pivotal role in elevating the skill set, confidence, and service delivery of our customer-facing support teams. Working within the Learning & Development (L&D) organization, the Tech Coach balances real-time technical guidance in internal support channels with structured quality checks, performance coaching, and documentation maintenance. This role acts as a strategic bridge between support technicians, supervisors, and training staff to ensure standard-setting customer experiences.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Provide real-time technical guidance and troubleshooting support in internal help channels.
* Guide technicians through complex or urgent customer issues by breaking down technical concepts and fostering problem-solving skills rather than simply providing direct answers.
* Instill confidence in frontline staff and set a high standard for customer interaction quality.
* Communicate with Operations and Engineering teams when new issues/bugs arise.
* Evaluate technician ticket, chat, and phone interactions against established QA/QC grading rubrics and automated grading checks.
* Perform monthly human verification audits on sample cases to maintain grading accuracy and calibrate evaluation systems.
* Conduct targeted manual case reviews for agents to isolate root causes and build remediation plans.
* Provide clear and useful feedback for administrators to improve customer service.
* Partner directly with leaders to deliver structured feedback, actionable performance insights, and trend analysis.
* Communicate both performance deficiencies and team accolades to leaders to aid in employee development and recognition.
* Participate in leadership syncs to align coaching priorities with team performance metrics.
* Draft, update, and maintain internal documentation articles to maintain brand consistency and availability of information.
* Identify missing or outdated documentation standard operating procedures during ticket reviews and update relevant sources.
* Assist with training, onboarding, and mentoring new technical hires as they transition onto active shifts.
* Serve as an approachable point of contact for new technicians during their early tenure to accelerate time-to-productivity.
* Drive technical advancement initiatives (e.g., Level 1 to Level 2/3 progression) by designing targeted coaching plans.
* Conduct 1-on-1 coaching sessions to address skill gaps, refine soft skills, and improve technical execution.
* Track recurring technical issues, error patterns, and support trends across shifts.
* Provide feedback and data insights to Trainers regarding widespread knowledge gaps to inform future training modules, team PSAs, and curriculum updates.

#### **Requirements**

* Strong proficiency in Web Hosting environments, Linux system administration, and command-line interfaces (CLI).
* Mastery of soft skills, with a demonstrated ability to explain complex technical topics in clear, approachable language.
* Friendly, positive, and energetic approach to mentoring peers and helping others succeed.
* Ability to review support cases, analyze performance data using rubric criteria, and draw objective conclusions.
* High comfort level working in fast-paced text and chat environments while balancing accuracy with responsiveness.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in technical coaching, mentoring, training, or QA role.
* Experience with specialized web hosting management tools.
* Familiarity with Salesforce CRM and QA evaluation tools.

title: Helpdesk Associate
description:
Position Overview

The Help Desk Associate provides front-line administrative and coordination support to the IT department. The role primarily involves answering incoming IT-related calls, recording user requests as tickets, and ensuring that requests are documented and routed to the appropriate support personnel. The position also assists with meeting scheduling, conference room arrangements, record maintenance, and other routine clerical and administrative activities to support the smooth day-to-day functioning of the department.

Duties and Responsibilities

* Answer incoming telephone calls to the IT department in a polite and professional manner.
* Record calls and user-reported issues as support tickets, ensuring that the details are clear and accurate.
* Categorize tickets and forward or assign them to the appropriate analyst or IT support team according to established procedures.
* Capture relevant details such as the caller’s name, department, contact information, and a brief description of the request or issue.
* Maintain call logs, ticket records, registers, and other trackers as required.
* Schedule meetings, coordinate invitations, and communicate meeting details to participants.
* Arrange conference rooms for meetings, including checking room availability and coordinating basic setup requirements.
* Assist with routine administrative tasks such as maintaining records, preparing simple documents, and handling correspondence as assigned.
* Coordinate with relevant staff to confirm meeting schedules, room bookings, and other logistical requirements.
* Direct calls or general enquiries to the appropriate person or department when required.
* Maintain confidentiality of internal information and handle user details responsibly.
* Perform other clerical and administrative duties assigned by the reporting manager.

Qualifications and Skills Required

Educational Qualifications

Higher Secondary education or a diploma/degree in any discipline. Qualifications in office administration, business administration, or computer applications are an added advantage.

Technical & Functional Skills

* Basic computer skills, including email, calendars, word processing, and spreadsheets.
* Ability to use ticketing systems or learn the department’s ticket logging procedures.
* Good data-entry accuracy and attention to detail.
* Basic meeting scheduling, calendar coordination, and record-keeping skills.

Core Competencies

* Clear verbal communication and professional telephone etiquette.
* Polite, patient, and service-oriented approach.
* Good organization, time management, and attention to detail.
* Ability to follow procedures and coordinate with different teams.
* Reliability, discretion, and willingness to support routine administrative needs.

Experience

0–2 years of experience in call handling, front-desk support, office administration, customer service, or a similar role. Freshers with good communication and basic computer skills may also be considered.

Experience in an IT department or a healthcare organization is an added advantage.

Pay: From ₹20,000.00 per month

title: Hardware/Desktop Support
description:
We are looking for a **System Analyst** to support and maintain the hospital’s end-user IT infrastructure, including desktops, operating systems, standard applications, printers, scanners, and other peripheral devices. The role involves installing, configuring, and troubleshooting hardware and software, performing preventive maintenance, handling OS updates and system recovery, maintaining IT asset inventory, and ensuring the smooth day-to-day functioning of user systems across hospital departments. The candidate will provide first- and second-level technical support, coordinate with vendors for hardware repairs and warranty services, assist with IT deployments and upgrades, and work closely with Network, Server, and Application teams to resolve technical issues.

The candidate is expected to follow hospital IT policies, standard operating procedures, and ISO 27001 information security guidelines, while maintaining proper documentation of incidents, asset movements, maintenance activities, and system configurations. Good troubleshooting, communication, coordination, and documentation skills are essential. **An understanding of how software applications work, including application workflows, databases, or system integrations, will be an added advantage.** Candidates who can identify opportunities for application improvements, suggest process automation, or contribute ideas for application development and optimization will be preferred.
